description:
Retrieve an AnnData object with donor-balanced, cell-type-stratified sampling.
Data: CZ CELLxGENE Census (human) · table var — one record = one gene (feature) measured in the human Census.
Key: feature_id.
Arguments: gene_symbols accepts hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); ensembl_ids accepts census feature (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence.
served as the derived sample: upstream's cell-type-stratified draw with donors keyed by (dataset_id, donor_id); the server fetches exactly the drawn cells and _vbt names the draw (derived_sample)
without a sample (the count failed, or too many cells to read) the filter must fix one dataset_id; otherwise unsupported_combination names single_cell.get_anndata
'No cells found' is an unverified empty (the filter may name values absent from this Census release)

ensembl_ids.description: Accepts census_feature; resolved to one census_feature (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

gene_symbols.description: Accepts hgnc_symbol; resolved to one hgnc_symbol (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

include_duplicates.description: Include duplicate records (cells counted in several datasets), which are excluded by default; their number is disclosed.

value_filter.description: Matched by the source's search engine: SOMA value_filter over obs columns; the gateway draws the donor-balanced sample with donors keyed by (dataset_id, donor_id).
